crime.value: Planned murder of a fugitive named Spikes via ambush at a remote diner; two armed men position themselves to kill Spikes when he jumps from a passing freight train and arrives at the location.
crime.quote: We're here to kill a man... We're going to kill a man named Spikes... at five-thirty that freight is coming through here.

victim.value: Spikes, a fugitive hiding in a boxcar who 'did something he shouldn't have done' and is being hunted by two contract killers intending to intercept him at the diner.
victim.quote: There's a man named Spikes hiding in one of the boxcars, and when it passes by here he's going to jump off.

closed_world.value: Charley's Oasis diner in the Arizona desert, isolated along a highway near railroad tracks, with limited personnel (old man, young waitress, and drifter Jack) and no outside help available before the scheduled murder.
closed_world.quote: The building, standing back from the highway, was almost equidistant between it and the tracks... a single-story, unpainted affair... Charley's Oasis.

culprit_and_motive.value: Frank and Earl, two armed contract killers hired to eliminate Spikes; their motive is professional—they have been paid to execute him as revenge or silencing for an unspecified prior offense.
culprit_and_motive.quote: Let's just say he did something he shouldn't have done... We're here to kill a man.

resolution.value: The old man throws hot coffee at Frank, Jack retrieves a hidden gun and shoots Earl in the shoulder, incapacitating both killers before Spikes arrives. The sheriff is called and arrives to arrest them; order is restored through improvised defensive violence by diner staff and an armed intervention.
resolution.quote: The old man, his hand sweeping upward... threw the pot of hot coffee at Frank... Jack had moved fast... snatched the gun out of the rags... and pulled the trigger.

investigator.value: Jack Hennessy, a fugitive drifter himself, accidentally becomes the primary actor in thwarting the murder plot; he serves as the reader's lens and undergoes personal moral transformation through the crisis.
investigator.quote: Jack, staring at them, felt a cold knot in his stomach... He made up his mind, suddenly... That's me running, he thought with a sudden realization.
